name: Reject Poison
prerequisites: Con 13, poison use class feature, worshiper of Norgorber
benefit: Whenever you fail the initial saving throw against poison, you have a 20% chance of naturally rejecting the toxin, negating its effects and wasting its use.
flavor: You are a careful poisoner, and know how to protect yourself against exposure to the ill effects of most substances.
text:
You are a careful poisoner, and know how to protect yourself against exposure to the ill effects of most substances.

**Prerequisites**: Con 13, poison use class feature, worshiper of Norgorber.

**Benefit**: Whenever you fail the initial saving throw against poison, you have a 20% chance of naturally rejecting the toxin, negating its effects and wasting its use.
